criteria.text: MCP exposes signer-first worker cordon, uncordon, drain, undrain, maintenance enter/exit, and labels update tools that return request/result/read-model correlation metadata.
Worker assignment state read model reports worker pubkey and active service/inference assignments with workload ID, status, pinned/movable flags, and timestamps.
Drain status read model reports drain start/reason, remaining assignments, pinned blockers, and maintenance/disable safety.
Eligibility preview read model uses WorkerPolicyService.RankWorkers and ML placement preview scoring to split eligible/rejected workers, scores, and selected winner.
Nostr projector publishes replaceable worker assignment and drain status read models from authoritative service/ML state without polling or sleep-based completion.
